title: temporal-drift-custody-integrity: code and derived data for chain-of-custody drift detection in digital video evidence
description: Reference implementation, forgery and evaluation scripts, saved experiment outputs and derived feature tables for the manuscript 'Temporal Drift-Anomaly & Co-Evasion Detection for Chain-of-Custody Integrity in Digital Evidence'. Raw videos (VISION, FloreView, WhatsApp pilot copies) are not included; forged files are regenerated by the scripts.
